meta.engagement: ISSB / IFRS Jurisdictional Obligation Register — Workstream 3 demo
meta.cadence: Weekly AI scan · monthly fact-check re-audit
meta.disclaimer: Demo built entirely from public filings — no client data. This is a curated excerpt from the full ISSB obligation register, selected to show every mechanism: confirmed in-scope, confirmed out-of-scope, and the work queue. Every row requires validation before use.

scanner.headline: Mexico NIS B-1 confirmed to catch NIF preparers regardless of listing
scanner.detail: CINIF guidance reaffirms that any entity preparing statements under Mexican NIF is caught — with no materiality threshold. This is a non-listing (incorporation) trigger.
scanner.recalc_note: Servicios Integrados (E132) moves from 'Not tested' to a priority IN-SCOPE candidate on the incorporation trigger — a row a listing-only tool would miss.

scanner.headline: EFRAG third-country ESRS draft approved — Art. 40a bites on non-EU parents
scanner.detail: Group EU turnover >€450m plus a qualifying EU subsidiary (>€200m) pulls the non-EU parent into scope from FY2028. TCCC has Irish, French and Dutch subsidiaries.
scanner.recalc_note: KO (E001) and Coca-Cola HBC (E002) both resolve to IN SCOPE on nexus+size — even though neither is EU-incorporated.

scanner.headline: CARB resets SB 253 deadline; SB 261 remains enjoined
scanner.detail: Modified SB 253 text (27 Jul 2026) after the June package withdrawal; Scope 1&2 deadline in flux. SB 261 enforcement paused under the Ninth Circuit injunction.
scanner.recalc_note: KO stays IN SCOPE for SB 253 (revenue ≫ $1bn, does business in CA) but the deadline field flips to VOLATILE — a dates-not-status change.

scanner.headline: Brazil reverses course — CVM Res. 244 makes ISSB voluntary
scanner.detail: The mandatory phase under Res. 193 was revoked. Reporting is now voluntary for B3-listed companies and funds.
scanner.recalc_note: Every Brazil row flips to OUT OF SCOPE with reason 'regime now voluntary (Res. 244)'. A register without effective-dating would still show these as mandatory.

scanner.headline: CCBA moves from KO to Coca-Cola HBC consolidation (targeted end-2026)
scanner.detail: On close, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (E005) shifts from KO consolidation (Scope 1/2) to equity-method under CCHBC (Scope 3). Ownership 66.52%→25%.
scanner.recalc_note: CCBA's boundary treatment recalculates across both parents — the clearest example of why rows carry VALID FROM / VALID TO dates.

scanner.headline: SEC proposes full rescission of its climate disclosure rules
scanner.detail: Comment period closed 3 Aug 2026. No enforceable federal climate-disclosure obligation while stayed and pending rescission.
scanner.recalc_note: KO's US/SEC row stays OUT OF SCOPE; monitor for final action.

spotlight.summary: One entity, three triggers, three different answers — why a single applicability column cannot work.
